opening.argument: This is a creator-run makeup giveaway offering four specified prizes, with winners chosen through a random drawing rather than through a financial or credential transaction. The listed rewards include two $20 gift cards and two branded makeup products, while the entry rules require subscribing, commenting on a desired item, and following the creator on Instagram. Sharing the video is presented only as an optional way to obtain an extra entry, consistent with ordinary audience engagement. The sampled frames visibly show the Instagram rule and makeup-related items associated with the offer. Prize delivery and account authenticity remain unresolved, but the presented structure is an ordinary rewards and promotional activity.
